summary: The Git Config Provider syncs files from a repo to the device using Repository (a Repository resource name), TargetRevision (branch, tag or commit), Path (repo directory mapped to /) and optional MountPath (device directory, default /); the Repository resource holds URL, protocol and credentials and is set up once.
